'''Obba''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who lived during the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic]]. A contemporary of [[Worror Dowmat]] and [[Valenthyne Farfalla]], who he served together as [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] in the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. After surviving the conflict, Obba was appointed to the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]], and spent many years searching for and recovering [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] and talismans. In [[990 BBY]], he was a member of the [[Ambria strike team|team]] sent to capture the last [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] on [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]]. Under the command of Master [[Tho'natu]], the team traveled to Ambria, where they were [[Confrontation on Ambria|attacked]] by a deranged [[Darovit]], driven mad by the [[Summon fear|Sith sorcery]] of his cousin [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]. Assuming him to be the Sith Lord, Tho'natu struck down Darovit, and the Jedi returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], bringing with them the [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilts]] of the five Jedi recently killed in the [[Duel on Tython|confrontation]] with Zannah and [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].

During his time with the Order Obba also trained two [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], [[Medd Tandar]] and [[Set Harth]], who aided him in his duties for the Council of First Knowledge. However, Harth was corrupted by the Sith artifacts he discovered during his travels and rejected the ways of the Jedi Order, becoming a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. He kept many of the artifacts he found for himself before leaving the Jedi and continuing to search for additional, similar relics to add to his collection. Tandar, meanwhile, was later killed by [[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]] on Doan during her [[Massacre on Doan|assassination]] of [[Gelba]], the leader of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[mining caste]] during his search for a cache of long-buried Sith artifacts and talismans. After Tandar's death, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]] of Doan met with Obba to assure him that the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] had not been ordered by the [[Doan Royal House]].

==Biography==
Originally a native of [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], Obba was at some point taken and trained as a Padawan by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. When war broke out with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], he joined the ranks of the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] under the command of [[Jedi Lord|Lord]] [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Hoth]]. Fighting alongside his companions, he survived the battles, returning to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with the army's dissolution with the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]. Along with Master [[Tho'natu]], Obba traveled to [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] as part of a [[Ambria strike team|strike team]] tasked with eliminating the Sith. Upon their arrival at [[Caleb]]'s camp, they found the hilts of five slain Jedi and a sickly individual they thought to be [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. In reality it was a deranged [[Darovit]], driven mad by [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]. Master Tho'natu struck down the sick Human, causing the Jedi to believe that the Sith were extinct.

In the wake of the costly battle with the Sith, the Order began to erase all memory from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] of Sith lore. A member of the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]], Master Obba trained many [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] the art of securing [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] for the Council. Taking [[Set Harth]] under his tutelage after the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan's]] first master's death, Harth eventually divorced himself from the Order, hoarding a secret stash of Sith artifacts for himself, and thus turned to the Dark Side. Another apprentice of Obba's, [[Medd Tandar]] completed the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] and began work for the Council. On a mission to [[Doan]] to recover a cash of talisman, Tandar was killed by [[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]], who was hired to kill a group of rebels plotting to overthrow the royal family of Doan.

Upon his former apprentice's death, Obba planned to begin a formal investigation on Doan. Not wanting a conflict with the Order, the Doan Royal Family sent a representative, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]] to ensure the Master that they would find and persecute the assassin. Meeting the diplomats in his [[Obba's quarters|private quarters]] in the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]], Master Obba agreed to the terms that Serra presented to him, promising to hold off an investigation if the Doanians provided concrete evidence absolving their involvement.
